name: More Resource Crates
label: Quest
description: More Resource Crates: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
That is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
That is what I want from you, friend. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, the League of Arathor has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more resource crates and bring them to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.
Once again, thank you friend. Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by footman and field marshal alike.
